concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage / T010 vs T001
concerns.text: FR-012(1) requires dataset-ID/URL verification BEFORE download, but the check is implemented in T010 while the stated execution order is 'T001 → … → T009, with T010's three checks gating T001'. A gate cannot be sequenced after the task it gates: as written, the first download (T001) runs unverified. Move the FR-012(1) check into T001 (or a T000 before it), keeping T010 for checks (2) and (3) or making T010 explicitly a re-usable module invoked by T001/T005/T009 rather than a later-stage task.

Same inversion for FR-012(3): T010's citation verification must gate T009's reporting, yet T009 precedes T010 in the execution order. Either T009 must invoke the citation check before writing research.md, or T010 must precede T009; as sequenced, research.md is produced before its citations are verified.

T001 is tagged [P] but it is the sole root task of the entire dependency chain (T002–T009 all transitively depend on it); nothing can run in parallel with it. The [P] tag is misleading — remove it or justify what it is parallel to.

The dependency section states 'T006 and T007 are parallel-safe with each other after T005' but only T006 carries the [P] tag; T007 does not. Tagging is inconsistent with the declared parallelism — either tag both or neither.
